findings.summary: Known host failure leaves the active input request pending indefinitely when the lost host never returns an ACK.
findings.impact: A future manager/UI awaiting that request cannot receive a terminal failure receipt from known host loss, and outstanding input metadata is retained. Lock is different: its host remains live and already-delivered work may keep its in-flight acknowledgement.
findings.recommendedRepair: On known host failure settle the active receipt immediately HOST_UNAVAILABLE, mark ambiguity, revoke queued work, and make all late ACK/rejection/finally callbacks inert. Do not replay, spawn, kill or interrupt commands through this pure component.
